title: refactor(core, plugin-security, plugin-sharing): one isFederatedObject binding, read from the spec predicate
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9H71EcHQuc15PBmrPVnshdn)_
Fixes #31849

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：“这个对象是不是联邦对象（ADR-0015 `external`）”在运行时只剩一个函数：core 的 `isFederatedObject`，它直接读 spec 的 `platformProvisionsStorage`；plugin-security、plugin-sharing 改为转出 core 的同一个函数，另外 7 处手写的 `external` 判断也改为调用它。
- 为什么改：同一个判断写了十来遍，将来“联邦”的含义一变（比如改读 `schemaMode`）就得逐处去找，漏一处就会出现两层答案不一致。
- 风险与回滚：行为不变：对所有对象记录以及 `null`、`undefined`、数组、原始值，新旧答案相同。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/security/tenant-field.ts`（`isFederatedObject` 本体）；`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/federated-phantom-anchors.ts`（删掉的副本）；`packages/core/src/security/tenant-field.test.ts`（新钉）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "external != null\|external == null" packages/core packages/objectql packages/plugins` 预期在非测试源码里零命中。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `@objectstack/core` `isFederatedObject` (`security/tenant-field.ts`) returns `!platformProvisionsStorage(schema)` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, the spelling #7865's convergence map names.
- `@objectstack/plugin-security` and `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` `federated-phantom-anchors.ts` drop their own copy (security: `external != null`; sharing: its own `!platformProvisionsStorage` wrapper) and `export { isFederatedObject }` from `@objectstack/core`. The export name stays where it was, so every importer keeps resolving. `@objectstack/objectql` keeps re-exporting the core binding, unchanged.
- The other runtime copies of the presence test, found by the measure below, now ask the same binding:
  - `packages/objectql/src/search-companion.ts` `isDdlManaged` (`external == null`)
  - `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/unmapped-columns.ts` (the "federated" outside reason)
  - `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts` (managed-drift driver scan)
  - `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migration-plugins.ts` (coverage pass `federated` count)
  - `packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts` `isExternalObject` (ADR-0062 D6 gate)
  - `packages/triggers/trigger-schedule/src/time-relative-trigger.ts` `organizationScopeIsInertFor`
  - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` (datasource-bound `external` read; was `!== undefined && !== null`)
- Comment-only rewording where a docblock named the old expression as the predicate: `objectql` `engine-driver-options.ts`, `integrity/dangling-reference-audit.ts`; `plugin-security` `security-plugin.ts`; `plugin-sharing` `sharing-service.ts`.
- One forced test edit: `packages/objectql/src/federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` gains a READERS row `search-companion.ts#isDdlManaged :: isFederatedObject()` (`not-a-read`), because the search companion now calls the seam by name.

## Why

Measure on `origin/main` 3f0e3ace (`git grep -n "external != null\|external == null\|external !== undefined\|isFederatedObject\|platformProvisionsStorage"` under `packages/`, non-test): besides the card's table, seven more source sites restated the presence test (listed above). Seat ruling 1 converges them too. Not converged, because they are a different question: `service-datasource` `external-datasource-service.ts:1374` (`external !== undefined || datasource !== 'default'`, a wider "routed off the default datasource" test) and `datasource-admin-service.ts` (`patch.external`, a patch field, not an object). `packages/spec` keeps the one definition (no spec edit).

Input equivalence (seat ruling 2): `platformProvisionsStorage` answers `true` (not federated) for `null`, `undefined`, arrays and any non-object, and the old `?.external != null` answered `false` (not federated) on each of those, so the two agree. The only inputs where they differ are a function or an array that carries an own `external` property; no producer hands one to these seams (all read registry or overlay object records).

## Tests

- `packages/core/src/security/tenant-field.test.ts` (new): `isFederatedObject(x) === !platformProvisionsStorage(x)` and the expected verdict for `{}`, `{ external: {} }`, `{ external: null }`, `{ external: undefined }`, `null`, `undefined`, `[]`; plus barrel identity.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/federated-object-binding.test.ts` and `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/federated-object-binding.test.ts` (new): the module export `toBe` core's binding.
- Why identity: a restored local copy answers the same as core on every record, so no behavioural pin can see it (measured: the core ablation below stays green). Identity is the only thing that changes.

<details><summary>Ablations (ruling 4), each restored with blob == HEAD and empty diff</summary>

- plugin-security: delete the core import and restore `export function isFederatedObject(schema) { return schema?.external != null }` → `federated-object-binding.test.ts` RED (`expected [Function isFederatedObject] to be [Function isFederatedObject] // Object.is equality`), `federated-tenant-layer0.test.ts` stays green (behaviour identical). Tests 1 failed | 8 passed.
- plugin-sharing: delete the core import and restore the old `!platformProvisionsStorage` wrapper → `federated-object-binding.test.ts` RED, same assertion; Tests 1 failed | 57 passed.
- core: revert the body to `?.external != null` → `tenant-field.test.ts` stays GREEN (8/8): the agreement pin cannot see a revert, by design, which is why the re-export layers carry the identity pin.
- Mutations landed through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, marker grep 1); tests import the module under test from `src`, so no dist leg.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Test files still name `external != null` in prose or as a test variant (e.g. `injected-system-columns-parity.test.ts`, the dangling-audit federated phantom test); they describe what a mutation would look like, not a predicate copy.
- `packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.ts:263` still says plugin-security holds a hand-rolled copy; that doc is spec prose and this card forbids `packages/spec/**` edits.

## Verification

Head `10eb82ed` (origin/main 1a66fcfe merged in; the merge brought #31876, which edits plugin-sharing and core in other files).

- `git grep -n "external != null\|external == null" packages/core packages/objectql packages/plugins` (non-test, CHANGELOG excluded): 0 hits. Under all of `packages/`, the only remaining hits are the definition in `packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.ts`.
- Build: `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**' --filter='./examples/**'` under the verify lock, VERDICT command-exit 0.

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck</summary>

At `10eb82ed` (after the main merge):
- core: typecheck + test, Test Files 141/141, Tests 3237/3237
- plugin-sharing: typecheck + test, Test Files 73/73, Tests 1497/1497
- plugin-security: typecheck + test, Test Files 252/252, Tests 6051 passed, 45 skipped
- objectql: typecheck + `federated-injected-column-readers`, `federated-object`, `search-companion*`, `package-scoped*` (6 files, 212/212)
- cli, metadata-protocol, service-analytics, trigger-schedule: typecheck, exit 0

At `73db2448` (before the merge; the code these suites exercise is unchanged since):
- objectql full: Test Files 580/580, Tests 11935/11935
- service-analytics full: Test Files 214/214, Tests 5140 passed, 332 skipped
- trigger-schedule full: Test Files 12/12, Tests 230/230
- metadata-protocol full: Test Files 330 passed, 5 skipped; Tests 22626 passed, 29 skipped
- cli `--project unit`: 404/406 on the first run. The 2 failures were `published-subpath-console.pin` and `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`, which need `packages/cli/dist` and stopped with "packages/cli is not built". After the full build they passed 2/2 (29 tests). The integration tier is left to CI.
- Lint: root eslint `--no-inline-config` on the changed `.ts` files, exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `10eb82ed`: all 80 derived families exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "80 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 80 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 0 anchors lost.
</details>

None; the seat lands it.
